rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for sarcasm, especially when mocking contempt is the main point.

example.english: This film uses a lot of sarcasm while joking about social issues.
example.traditional: 呢套戲用好多諷刺手法，笑住講社會問題。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 jung6 hou2 do1 fung3 ci3 sau2 faat3 siu3 zyu6 gong2 se5 wui2 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for pointed, personal sarcasm that is meant to make someone feel small.

example.english: You don't have to use sarcasm to make fun of people's weight all the time; it's hurtful.
example.traditional: 你唔使成日挖苦人哋肥，咁樣好傷人㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 seng4 jat6 waa1 fu2 jan4 dei6 fei4 gam3 joeng2 hou2 soeng1 jan4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when the sarcasm specifically works by saying the opposite of what is meant.

example.english: He said, “You're really punctual,” but it was sarcasm because I was half an hour late.
example.traditional: 佢話「你真係好準時喎」，其實係講反話，因為我遲到咗半個鐘。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa5 nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 zeon2 si4 wo3 kei4 sat6 hai6 gong2 faan2 waa2 jan1 wai6 ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1
